channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: Gavin Newsom Memoir Hits Top of Best-Sellers Chart Hours After Release
item.description: The new book seeks to position Newsom as an underdog, who has lived his whole life trying to make his home state proud.

item.title: Whistleblower Claims Paramount President Jeff Shell Leaked Details of $7.7 Billion UFC Deal
item.description: The studio has brought on an outside law firm to investigate the allegations, which have also been alerted to the SEC.

item.title: Box Office Preview: ‘Scream 7’ Set to Deliver Year’s Top Opening With $40 Million-Plus
item.description: Many pundits believe the slasher pic will make franchise history in besting the $44.4 million domestic launch of the last installment. Globally, the movie is eyeing a $60 million start.

item.title: David Ellison, Erika Kirk and Kevin O’Leary to Attend State of the Union as Media Personalities Descend on DC
item.description: The Paramount mogul and new media power brokers are among the invited guests for President Trump's address to Congress Tuesday.

item.title: NAACP Image Awards: Kendrick Lamar, SZA, Cardi B Among Night Two Non-Televised Winners
item.description: The awards in the music and podcast categories were announced during a virtual show exclusively on YouTube Tuesday.

item.title: One of Eric Dane’s Final Roles Was Boosting Visibility for ALS: “Used His Platform Not for Attention, But for Action”
item.description: The 'Grey’s Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' actor died on Feb. 19 following a battle with the rare degenerative disease.

item.title: ‘Wisecrack’ Wins Podcast Of The Year at 2026 Ambies
item.description: Kara Swisher and the late Reggie Ossé also both received honors at the ceremony in Brooklyn Tuesday.
